subject: Startups
title: Working Hours and Burnout
description: One-minute skill: Working Hours and Burnout.

hook.text: Elon Musk says nobody changed the world working 40 hours a week.

buildup.text: Startup culture often glorifies overwork: sleeping at the office, weekend sprints, and bragging about hours logged.

discovery.text: Studies show that sustained work beyond 50 hours weekly leads to errors, poor decisions, and long-term health damage.

twist.text: Basecamp built a $100M business with 40-hour weeks. They proved intensity matters more than duration.

climax.text: Burnout kills retention. The best people leave when they're exhausted. Sustainable pace is a competitive advantage.

punchline.text: Sprint when needed. But don't call a marathon a sprint.

quiz.question: At what weekly hour threshold does productivity typically decline?
